passing_score.verbatim: Your understanding of highway signs and markings, traffic laws and safe driving practices will

exam_facts.note: The handbook's Testing page (physical p12, printed 12) says knowledge of signs, markings, traffic laws and safe driving is tested on automated equipment or paper, that an oral exam may be requested, that Basic Class C testing is also offered in Spanish, and that a $25 initial test fee and a $10 retest fee apply. Full-text searches for pass/percent/questions/correct/score found no question count, no passing score or percent and no time limit anywhere in the handbook (all null, not imported from memory). Physical page = printed page throughout. Page 1 (cover) carries the title and the 'DMV 700 March 2024' edition but no agency name in its text layer; the agency appears on physical p3. Motorcycle permit/license detail is part of the Chapter 1 page run but motorcycle and commercial knowledge are scoped out; new-resident vehicle registration (p83), office locations (p84) and acknowledgements (p85-86) are not mapped.
